capabilities: Add the full folder context menu to the vault-name row
Open the same menu from the empty area below the file list
Remove entries that cannot apply to the vault, such as Rename and Delete
extras: Documentation is structured as a demo vault that ships with each release and can be opened via a command; beta versions install through the BRAT plugin.
intentEvidence: This plugin gives both spots the same context menu any other folder gets
problem: The vault root and the empty space under the file list only get a short context menu, so acting on the top level requires using another folder or the ribbon.
summary: File Explorer tweak that adds the full folder right-click menu to the vault root row and the empty area below the file list.
